name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Cody, Trout, and Shrimp belong to different catches.
Mabel goes with exactly two of Crappie, Willowmere, and Leech.
Wade does not go with Carp.
Shrimp goes with either Cody or Crappie (but not both).
Crappie goes with neither Royce nor Dough.
Trout goes with at least one of Willowmere or Leech.
Dough goes with at least one of Carp or Willowmere.
Wade, Crappie, Foxglen, and Leech belong to different catches.
Trout goes with exactly one of Mabel, Royce, or Mossbank.
